caption: The drawing displays three objects arranged horizontally on a plain, light background. In the center is a detailed, colored illustration of an object resembling a two-pronged hairpin or ornament. The item has two straight, tapered prongs colored in wood-like brown and orange shades, with decorative, intertwined loops at the top rendered in yellows and golds, suggesting metal. On either side of the central image are two outline sketches: the one to the left shows a single-sided version, with a slightly curved body and a decorative top; the one on the right outlines a pair similar to the central object, with the same interlocking, rounded top but with less detail and no color. The paper is light beige, and some small spots of discoloration are visible, mostly to the left.
title: Amber Hairpin
